admin.description: Contract admin (also protocol-fee recipient when fee is set).

auto_execute_ingress.description: Governance flag: allow a relayer to auto-execute `Purchase` from Nostr ingress. **Default false** — parse-intent only. The contract never submits txs itself.

min_buffer_blocks.description: Settlement buffer in blocks. Default **7**. Allowed range **5–10**.

protocol_fee_bps.description: Optional protocol fee in basis points (100 = 1%). Taken on settle.
